# Memfit AI

> Memfit AI 是 Yaklang 生态的开源网络安全 AI Agent 编排框架，采用递归式双引擎（ReAct+Plan）架构，让 AI 拥有看得见的行动力。提供记忆/RAG、工具/Forges、自旋检测等能力，面向安全自动化与代码审计场景。

## 技术架构
- [数据流与人机交互](https://memfit.ai/docs/product/architecture/data-flow/): Memfit AI 的端到端数据流：从用户输入、记忆检索、工具执行到结果回流，以及人机交互与干预机制的设计。
- [核心架构：递归式双引擎架构](https://memfit.ai/docs/product/architecture/recursive-dual-engine/): 详解 Memfit AI 的递归式双引擎架构：ReAct 引擎实时推理与行动，Plan 引擎任务分解与规划，二者递归协作完成复杂安全任务。
- [Agentic 可靠性保障](https://memfit.ai/docs/product/architecture/reliability/): Memfit AI 的可靠性保障机制：自旋检测、记忆增强、反思决策等，确保 Agent 在长流程安全任务中稳定可控。
- [协调器](https://memfit.ai/docs/product/features/coordinator/): Memfit AI 协调器：负责任务调度与多 Agent 协作，编排递归式双引擎的执行流程与上下文管理。
- [记忆与 RAG](https://memfit.ai/docs/product/features/memory-rag/): Memfit AI 的记忆与 RAG 系统：持久化知识库、检索增强生成，让 AI Agent 记得住上下文、查得到证据。
- [ReAct 循环](https://memfit.ai/docs/product/features/react-loop/): Memfit AI 的 ReAct 循环引擎：推理（Reason）与行动（Act）交替执行，实时响应环境反馈完成安全任务。
- [工具与 Forges](https://memfit.ai/docs/product/features/tools-forges/): Memfit AI 的工具与 Forges 体系：可扩展的工具调用与 Forge 机制，连接 Yaklang 安全能力与外部系统。
- [概览](https://memfit.ai/docs/product/overview/): Memfit AI 是 Yaklang 生态的开源网络安全 AI Agent 编排框架，采用递归式双引擎（ReAct+Plan）架构，面向安全自动化与代码审计场景。
- [安全自动化](https://memfit.ai/docs/product/use-cases/automation/): Memfit AI 实现智能安全自动化，将 AI 驱动的决策与 Yaklang 强大的脚本能力相结合。
- [代码审计](https://memfit.ai/docs/product/use-cases/code-review/): Memfit AI 提供智能代码审计能力，结合静态分析与 AI 驱动的理解来识别安全漏洞和代码质量问题。
- [安全审计](https://memfit.ai/docs/product/use-cases/security-audit/): Memfit AI 在安全审计场景的应用：自动化漏洞检测、代码审计与风险分析，提升安全团队的审计效率。

## 使用手册
- [你好，Memfit！](https://memfit.ai/docs/help/quick-start/hello-memfit/): 本章是 Memfit 的基础导览。它不会把每个功能都讲完，而是帮助你建立第一张地图：Memfit 的界面由哪些区域组成、第一次任务如何开始、遇到知识库和 Skills 时应该去读哪篇教程。
- [认识与安装 Memfit AI](https://memfit.ai/docs/help/quick-start/installation/): Memfit AI 快速开始：环境准备、macOS/Linux/Windows 安装步骤与首次运行，几分钟上手 Yaklang 官方 AI Agent 框架。
- [基础配置与自定义 AI 配置](https://memfit.ai/docs/help/quick-start/tier-ai/): Memfit AI 快速开始：权限控制与基础参数配置、自定义 AI 模型接入，安装后建议先完成的两类设置。
- [高级使用](https://memfit.ai/docs/help/tutorials/advanced/): 本章面向已经能完成基础任务的用户，介绍如何观察模型表现、排查缓存和上下文问题、主动干预执行过程，以及把团队能力沉淀为自定义工具和 SKILL。
- [自定义工具与自定义 SKILL](https://memfit.ai/docs/help/tutorials/advanced/custom-tools-and-skills/): 当你发现某个操作会反复出现，就应该把它从“每次都写提示词”升级为“可复用能力”。在 Memfit 中，工具负责原子动作，SKILL 负责场景流程。
- [人工干预与上下文修改](https://memfit.ai/docs/help/tutorials/advanced/intervention-and-context/): Memfit 的 Agent 执行过程不是黑盒。你可以在计划、工具调用、SKILL 执行、输出整理等阶段主动干预，让它停下来、改方向、补充约束，或调整后续上下文。
- [用量与模型表现](https://memfit.ai/docs/help/tutorials/advanced/usage-and-model-performance/): 当一次任务变贵、变慢或结果开始不稳定时，先看用量面板。Memfit 会把模型调用过程中的输入、输出、缓存、上下文压力和速度数据展示出来，帮助你判断问题发生在上下文、模型选择、网络连接，还是任务本身。
- [Agent 使用教程](https://memfit.ai/docs/help/tutorials/ai-agent/): Memfit AI Agent 完整上手教程：从创建 Agent、配置工具与技能，到执行安全任务的端到端实战示例。
- [知识库系统教程](https://memfit.ai/docs/help/tutorials/knowledge-base/): 知识库让 Memfit 能基于你的资料工作。它适合存放产品文档、团队规范、项目说明、安全资料、历史经验和需要长期复用的领域知识。
- [如何加载和使用 SKILLS](https://memfit.ai/docs/help/tutorials/skills/): Skills 是 Memfit 的场景化能力包。一个 Skill 通常会组合提示词、工具、参数表单和执行策略，让 Agent 在特定任务上更稳定。

## 开发者指南
- [专注模式开发者总览](https://memfit.ai/docs/help/focus-mode-dev/): 高度可定制化的 AI 原子任务执行系统：把 ReAct 的非确定性 LLM 推理与确定性的工程能力（Hook、LiteForge、验证门、自旋检测）拼成可组合的领域子循环。
- [04. Action 体系](https://memfit.ai/docs/help/focus-mode-dev/actions/): LoopAction 是专注模式的原子动作单元。本章讲清 Action 的结构定义、注册方式、同步/异步模式与执行生命周期。
- [01. 架构与执行流程](https://memfit.ai/docs/help/focus-mode-dev/architecture/): ReActLoop 主循环的完整执行流程：工厂创建、每轮"推理-行动-感知"迭代与终止条件，核心字段按职责分组解读。
- [10. 端到端：从零构建一个 loop_xxx](https://memfit.ai/docs/help/focus-mode-dev/build-your-own-loop/): 12 步实战构建一个完整的专注模式 loop_log_analyze（日志异常分析与报告），可直接作为新 loop 的开发模板。
- [09. Capabilities：能力体系与发现](https://memfit.ai/docs/help/focus-mode-dev/capabilities/): reactloops 把所有 AI 可调用的资源统一抽象为 Capability：能力的发现、注入与调用方式，以及"子 loop 即能力"的复用模型。
- [11. 案例研究：17 个专注模式横向对比](https://memfit.ai/docs/help/focus-mode-dev/case-studies/): 对 reactloops 目录下已注册的 17 个专注模式做横向对比，并深度拆解其中 5 个最有学习价值的 loop。
- [12. 调试与可观测性](https://memfit.ai/docs/help/focus-mode-dev/debugging-and-observability/): reactloops 内置的多层调试基础设施：如何事后查看每一轮的 prompt、action、感知与意图识别快照。
- [08. 确定性四件套：感知 / 反思 / 自旋 / 验证门](https://memfit.ai/docs/help/focus-mode-dev/determinism-mechanisms/): 用感知、反思、自旋检测、验证门四个机制，把非确定的 LLM 循环约束为可承诺的确定性行为。
- [06. Emitter 与流式输出](https://memfit.ai/docs/help/focus-mode-dev/emitter-and-streaming/): Emitter 是专注模式与外部世界（前端 UI、CLI、日志）通信的唯一通道：事件模型与流式输出实现。
- [05. Hook 与生命周期](https://memfit.ai/docs/help/focus-mode-dev/hooks-and-lifecycle/): Hook 是专注模式为边界事件预留的扩展点：LoopFactory 的生命周期时序与各 Hook 的触发时机。
- [07. LiteForge：把不确定塞进确定的盒子](https://memfit.ai/docs/help/focus-mode-dev/liteforge/): LiteForge 把非确定的 LLM 输出装进确定的中间步骤：受约束的提示词-解析-校验管线设计。
- [02. Options 完整参考](https://memfit.ai/docs/help/focus-mode-dev/options-reference/): options.go 全部 With* 选项的使用手册，按职责分组并给出代码示例。
- [03. Prompt 系统](https://memfit.ai/docs/help/focus-mode-dev/prompt-system/): 每轮主循环 prompt 的组装方式：模板结构、占位符来源、两层渲染机制、防注入与调试方法。
- [14. 流式输出与 UX 实战](https://memfit.ai/docs/help/focus-mode-dev/streaming-ux/): 边算边流的体验设计：如何让专注模式逐步输出结果，建立用户对 Agent 执行过程的信任。
- [13. Yak 专注模式（Yak Focus Mode）](https://memfit.ai/docs/help/focus-mode-dev/yak-focus-mode/): 在 Yak 脚本中运行完整 ReActLoop 能力的专注模式：不因脚本形态阉割任何 Agent 能力。

## English Docs
- [Hello, Memfit!](https://memfit.ai/en/docs/help/quick-start/hello-memfit/): This chapter is a basic orientation for Memfit. It does not explain every feature in depth; it gives you the first map: what the main interface contains, how to start your first task, and where to go next for knowledge bases, Skills, and advanced usage.
- [Getting Started with Memfit AI](https://memfit.ai/en/docs/help/quick-start/installation/): Quick start with Memfit AI — environment setup, installation on macOS/Linux/Windows, and first run. Get going with Yaklang's official AI Agent framework in minutes.
- [Basic Settings and Custom AI Configuration](https://memfit.ai/en/docs/help/quick-start/tier-ai/): Memfit AI quick start — tool permissions and basic parameters, plus custom AI provider and model setup; two recommended settings to complete right after installation.
- [Advanced Usage](https://memfit.ai/en/docs/help/tutorials/advanced/): This chapter covers model usage inspection, cache and context diagnostics, manual intervention during execution, and custom tools or SKILLs for reusable team workflows.
- [Custom Tools and Custom SKILLs](https://memfit.ai/en/docs/help/tutorials/advanced/custom-tools-and-skills/): When an operation repeats, turn it from "write the prompt again" into a reusable capability. In Memfit, tools are atomic actions, while SKILLs are scenario workflows.
- [Manual Intervention and Context Editing](https://memfit.ai/en/docs/help/tutorials/advanced/intervention-and-context/): Memfit Agent execution is not a black box. During planning, tool calls, SKILL execution, and final reporting, you can pause, redirect, add constraints, or adjust context for later steps.
- [Usage and Model Performance](https://memfit.ai/en/docs/help/tutorials/advanced/usage-and-model-performance/): When a task becomes expensive, slow, or unstable, start with the usage panel. Memfit shows input, output, cache, context pressure, and speed data so you can tell whether the issue comes from context, model selection, network behavior, or the task itself.
- [Agent Tutorial](https://memfit.ai/en/docs/help/tutorials/ai-agent/): A complete hands-on Memfit AI Agent tutorial — from creating an agent and configuring tools and skills to executing a security task end-to-end.
- [Knowledge Base Tutorial](https://memfit.ai/en/docs/help/tutorials/knowledge-base/): Knowledge bases let Memfit work from your materials instead of relying only on model training data. Use them for product docs, team standards, vulnerability data, project notes, and reusable operational experience.
- [Loading and Using SKILLS](https://memfit.ai/en/docs/help/tutorials/skills/): Skills are scenario-based capability packages. A Skill usually combines prompts, tools, parameter forms, and execution strategy so Agent can handle a specific class of tasks more consistently.
- [Data Flow & Human Interaction](https://memfit.ai/en/docs/product/architecture/data-flow/): The end-to-end data flow of Memfit AI — from user input, memory retrieval, and tool execution to results and feedback — and the design of its human interaction and intervention mechanisms.
- [Core Architecture - Recursive Dual-Engine](https://memfit.ai/en/docs/product/architecture/recursive-dual-engine/): Deep dive into Memfit AI's recursive dual-engine architecture: a ReAct engine for real-time reasoning and action, and a Plan engine for task decomposition, working recursively together.
- [Agentic Reliability Assurance](https://memfit.ai/en/docs/product/architecture/reliability/): Memfit AI's reliability mechanisms — spin detection, memory augmentation, and reflective decision-making — keep the agent stable and controllable across long-running security tasks.
- [Coordinator](https://memfit.ai/en/docs/product/features/coordinator/): The Memfit AI Coordinator handles task scheduling and multi-agent collaboration, orchestrating the execution flow and context management of the recursive dual-engine.
- [Memory & RAG](https://memfit.ai/en/docs/product/features/memory-rag/): Memfit AI's memory and RAG system: a persistent knowledge base with retrieval-augmented generation so the AI agent remembers context and finds evidence.
- [ReAct Loop](https://memfit.ai/en/docs/product/features/react-loop/): The Memfit AI ReAct loop engine alternates reasoning and action, responding in real time to environmental feedback to complete security tasks.
- [Tools & Forges](https://memfit.ai/en/docs/product/features/tools-forges/): Memfit AI's tools and Forges system: an extensible tool-calling and Forge mechanism that connects Yaklang security capabilities with external systems.
- [Overview](https://memfit.ai/en/docs/product/overview/): Memfit AI is the open-source cybersecurity AI Agent orchestration framework of the Yaklang ecosystem, built on a recursive dual-engine (ReAct + Plan) architecture for security automation and code auditing.
- [Security Automation](https://memfit.ai/en/docs/product/use-cases/automation/): Memfit AI enables intelligent security automation, combining AI-driven decision making with Yaklang's powerful scripting capabilities.
- [Code Review](https://memfit.ai/en/docs/product/use-cases/code-review/): Memfit AI provides intelligent code review capabilities, combining static analysis with AI-powered understanding to identify security vulnerabilities and code quality issues.
- [Security Audit](https://memfit.ai/en/docs/product/use-cases/security-audit/): Applying Memfit AI to security audits — automated vulnerability detection, code auditing, and risk analysis that boost security team efficiency.

## Focus Mode Developer Guide (EN)
- [Focus Mode Developer Overview](https://memfit.ai/en/docs/help/focus-mode-dev/): A highly customizable atomic-task execution system for AI: combining non-deterministic LLM reasoning with deterministic engineering capabilities (Hooks, LiteForge, validation gates, spin detection) into composable domain sub-loops.
- [04. Action System](https://memfit.ai/en/docs/help/focus-mode-dev/actions/): LoopAction, the atomic action unit of focus modes — structure, registration, sync/async modes, and execution lifecycle.
- [01. Architecture and Execution Flow](https://memfit.ai/en/docs/help/focus-mode-dev/architecture/): The complete ReActLoop main-loop execution flow: factory creation, per-iteration reason-act-perceive cycles, and termination conditions.
- [10. End-to-End: Build a loop_xxx from Scratch](https://memfit.ai/en/docs/help/focus-mode-dev/build-your-own-loop/): A 12-step walkthrough building a complete focus mode (loop_log_analyze) that you can use as a template for new loops.
- [09. Capabilities: Discovery and System](https://memfit.ai/en/docs/help/focus-mode-dev/capabilities/): How reactloops unifies all AI-callable resources as Capabilities: discovery, injection, invocation, and "sub-loop as capability".
- [11. Case Study: 17 Focus Modes Compared](https://memfit.ai/en/docs/help/focus-mode-dev/case-studies/): A side-by-side comparison of the 17 registered focus modes, with deep dives into the 5 most instructive ones.
- [12. Debugging and Observability](https://memfit.ai/en/docs/help/focus-mode-dev/debugging-and-observability/): The built-in multi-layer debugging infrastructure: inspecting per-iteration prompts, actions, perception, and intent-recognition snapshots.
- [08. The Determinism Quartet: Perception / Reflection / Spin / Validation Gates](https://memfit.ai/en/docs/help/focus-mode-dev/determinism-mechanisms/): Four mechanisms that constrain the non-deterministic LLM loop into promisable, deterministic behavior.
- [06. Emitter and Streaming Output](https://memfit.ai/en/docs/help/focus-mode-dev/emitter-and-streaming/): Emitter, the sole channel between focus modes and the outside world (frontend UI, CLI, logs): event model and streaming.
- [05. Hooks and Lifecycle](https://memfit.ai/en/docs/help/focus-mode-dev/hooks-and-lifecycle/): Hooks as extension points for boundary events: LoopFactory lifecycle sequence and when each hook fires.
- [07. LiteForge: Boxing Non-Determinism](https://memfit.ai/en/docs/help/focus-mode-dev/liteforge/): LiteForge packs non-deterministic LLM output into deterministic intermediate steps: a constrained prompt-parse-validate pipeline.
- [02. Options Complete Reference](https://memfit.ai/en/docs/help/focus-mode-dev/options-reference/): A user manual for every With* option in options.go, grouped by responsibility with code examples.
- [03. Prompt System](https://memfit.ai/en/docs/help/focus-mode-dev/prompt-system/): How each main-loop prompt is assembled: templates, placeholder sources, two-layer rendering, injection defense, and debugging.
- [14. Streaming Output and UX in Practice](https://memfit.ai/en/docs/help/focus-mode-dev/streaming-ux/): Experience design for incremental output: how streaming builds user trust in agent execution.
- [13. Yak Focus Mode](https://memfit.ai/en/docs/help/focus-mode-dev/yak-focus-mode/): Running the full ReActLoop capability inside Yak scripts, without any feature stripped.
